game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge, a bridge in a blizzard: the innkeeper must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Boolean Guards: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints.
theme: Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge: a bridge in a blizzard
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Bridge, repeat each round: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints. Each round, snow wraiths strike the hold gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the guards value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the hold gate from snow wraiths in Blizzard Bridge: keep the guards meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: guards drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 59-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Boolean Guards
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guards changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Blizzard Bridge.
